integrity: The proof is analytic; numerical checks corroborate examples but are not infinite certificates. No independent mathematical audit has been undertaken.
limitations: Unit S^2 spherical lunes of opening 0<alpha<=pi, squared ambient Euclidean chord lengths only; full distributions and geodesic variances are not determined. The optimal root is transcendental and historical priority is provisional.
title: A unique least-dispersed spherical lune for random squared chords
